notes.title: Update – postponed Early Access release
notes.content:
[p][/p][p][b]Release Update – New Timeline [/b][/p][p]Hey everyone,[/p][p]We’ve made the decision to [b]shift the Early Access[/b] and full release of [i]Cult of the Child Eater[/i] by [b]about 2–3 months[/b].[/p][p]This wasn’t an easy call — we know many of you are eager to play — but this extra time will help us deliver the kind of horror experience we’ve always aimed for: one that’s immersive, polished, and fully worth your time.[/p][p]While we haven’t shared much publicly over the past few months, development has never slowed down for a second. We’ve been working hard behind the scenes, and the current internal version of the game already includes many new features, improvements, and content that go far beyond what’s currently available in the public build.[/p][p][b]Here’s what the extra time is helping us focus on:[/b][/p][list][*][p]More puzzles overall — including co-op-friendly designs that are more satisfying and encourage player collaboration[/p][/*][*][p]Stronger, more dynamic horror moments that build tension[/p][/*][*][p]A plethora of new gameplay features and more extensive progression systems to keep players engaged over time[/p][/*][*][p]A more fleshed-out story with expanded lore and richer worldbuilding[/p][/*][*][p]Extensive bug fixing and polish to improve visuals, boost performance, and ensure a smoother, more stable gameplay experience

[/p][/*][/list][p]And don’t worry — you won’t be left in the dark while we continue development. Starting now, we’ll be posting more regular updates, behind-the-scenes insights, and progress previews across our channels. If you’ve been curious about what’s going on, you’ll be able to follow it all much more closely.[/p][p]Thank you for your continued support and patience — it means a lot to us.[/p][p]
— Uncle George Games
 Follow our progress:
 [url="https://linktr.ee/uncle.george.games"]linktr.ee/uncle.george.games[/url][/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Demo Patch Notes 06.13
notes.content: [p][b]Demo Patch Notes[/b] [b]06.13 – Patch 1.1.75[/b] * [b]New Stuff[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Improved Voice Chat stability and audio transmission through walls and floors,[/p][/*][*][p]If Voice Chat fails to connect, players can still continue the game without it,[/p][/*][*][p]Cultists now react to Windows’ default microphone input instead of Voice Chat data,[/p][/*][*][p]Refined Whack-A-Monster puzzle responsiveness and improved its sound effects,[/p][/*][*][p]Added a pop-up in the lobby when creating a room to highlight the importance on who should be creating the room[/p][p],[/p][/*][/list][p][b]Bug Fixes[/b] [/p][list][*][p]Fixed the end-game screen's inconsistent characters and XP UI errors when someone left or had a poor connection,[/p][/*][*][p]Corrected Cryptex puzzle ring-rotation interaction issues,[/p][/*][*][p]Fixed several incorrect puzzle spawn locations,[/p][/*][*][p]Ensured Hot’n’Cold puzzle now appears in all intended lavatories, not just one[/p][/*][/list]

notes.title: Playtest Patch Note
notes.content:
1.1.43 patch notes:
New Features:

Added unique sound effects for each channeling animation.,
Now there is an automatic puzzle selection when the previous one is solved.,
Added a sound effect and voice line when an Exit door opens.,
Added map indicators to indicate the opening of an Exit door.,
The 5th ping, which puts your pinging on cooldown is now a different color.,

Puzzle Improvements:

Revamped the visual design of the Quiz puzzle.,
Fixed inconsistencies in the new Quiz questions and added brand-new, verified questions.,
Reworked the Picture Sorter puzzle for more dynamic gameplay and resolved related bugs.,
Modified Photo Zoomer: color-based solutions now enlarge pieces instead of changing their color.,
Corrected the Experiment puzzle so players can no longer stack flasks on each other.,

UI Improvements:

Updated Channeling UI to display current action details.,
Journal based solution input now provides proper feedback on incorrect puzzle solutions.,
Added an inventory-full indicator.,
Added even more first-time examine indicators for new items.,
Replaced the "Solve it" Button with "Enter Code" button under journal based solution puzzles.,
Added an "Objectives Updated" indicator on the UI when a puzzle location was revealed on the Map.,

Bug Fixes & Stability:

Fixed several voice-chat issues.,
Multiple minor fixes and polish across UI and systems.

notes.title: PlayTest PatchNote
notes.content:
1.1.29 Patch went live today!

General
Fixed the examine and drop confusion on the Controls UI,,
Unusable (placeholder) items are now not lootable,,
Collectible items are now labeled properly as “Collectibles” (these are just placeholders in the playtest version),,
New tutorial/onboarding screens on first playthrough (can be reset in Settings → Reset Tutorial),,
Puzzle items are now automatically removed from the inventory once they're no longer needed (e.g., fuses and other puzzle items won't clutter your inventory once they are solved),,
Fixed several uninteractable items and incorrect puzzle spawn positions,,
Player icons on the map have been updated for better visibility,,
Added new map icons for players who are downed or being carried,,
All puzzle-related icons on the map are now yellow instead of white,,
Maximized self-revive penalty to prevent it from scaling indefinitely,,

Item Balance Updates:
Several items received buffs,,
Small Mirrors and Sacred Crosses can now be used on both humans and NPCs,,
Small Mirror immobilize duration increased from 6 → 8 seconds for monsters, and now applies 4 seconds to humans,,
Sacred Cross immobilize duration increased from 6 → 8 seconds for humans, and now applies 4 seconds to monsters,,
Increased the sound radius of Firecracker, Radio, and Bottle to attract NPCs more effectively,,
Increased the duration of the Nun soda stamina boost from 10 -> 20 seconds,,
Temporarily removed the Rosary — it will return once fixed,,
Updated item and puzzle descriptions to reflect these changes,,

Puzzle Fixes and Updates:
Fixed a Symbol-based puzzle bug,,
Quiz puzzle questions replaced with ones that emphasize reasoning over vocabulary,,
Fixed an issue with the Mastermind puzzle,,
Fixed an issue with the Nine Buttons puzzle,,
Hot N Cold puzzle functionality changed (no spoilers—figure it out!)

notes.title: Join the Cult of the Child Eater Playtest on 21 Feb 2025!
notes.content:
Dear Players,

This isn’t your typical valentine’s day party ːsteamhappyː. 

This spine chilling event is an exclusive invite to a select few players to test their mettle against the[b] Cult of the Child Eater on Friday, Feb 21, 9:00 am[/b]. This is your chance to experience a part of the game before its early access release and feedback your thoughts directly with us, the game designers.  

[b]What’s in the Playtest? [/b]
[list]
[*] One building, one floor of the main map 
[*] One type of NPC to interact with (or escape from...) 
[*] Three unique puzzles to challenge your mind 
[*] Collectible items with specific uses hidden throughout the area  
[*] You can't play yet against the Child Eater! ːsteamsadː  
[/list]

[b]Playtest Goals: [/b]
We’re looking for feedback on: 
[list]
[*] NPC interactions and possible exploits  
[*] Network stability during multiplayer gameplay  
[*] Feedback on items, teamwork and puzzles  
[/list]

How to Join?  
[list]
[*] Register for the playtest on Steam.  
[*] Join our [url=https://discord.com/invite/6Gu3a9qqA2]Discord[/url] (Required for testers)  
[*] Share your feedback in the #playtest-feedback channel 
[/list]

Your input will directly influence the development of Cult of the Child Eater.

Keep you posted about the game's story, items  in the game, puzzles, and monsters.
